description: RevOps plugin hooks — cwd-aware SessionStart banner when an SFDX project is reachable from the user's pwd

hooks.command: { printf '[%s] revops hook fired in cwd=%s\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')" "$PWD" >> /tmp/revops-banner.log; bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/sfdx-banner.sh" | tee -a /tmp/revops-banner.log; }
